check = [[0] * (max_i + 1) for _ in range(max_i + 1)]

for i in range(1, max_i + 1):

        if check[i - 1][j + 1] == 1 or check[i - 1][j - 1] == 1:
            memo[i][j] = (memo[i][j] + 1) % MOD
        else:
            check[i][j] = 1

print(memo[2 * nVal][0])
